howToRefresh: Ingest the KY History morning email to public/content/raw-briefs/YYYY-MM-DD.md, run npm run parse-briefs, then npm run build (includes build-home-preview). The preview page also re-reads stories.json in the browser.

features.title: Shepherdsville on Salt River
features.summary: On December 11, 1793, the young Kentucky General Assembly established a town on fifty acres of Adam Shepherd's land on the north side of Salt River, at the falls where the…
features.quote: On December 11, 1793, the young Kentucky General Assembly established a town on fifty acres of Adam Shepherd's land on the north side of Salt River, at the falls where the great road to Bullitt's Lick crossed.

features.title: Shawnee Chillicothe divisions
features.summary: The Shawnee were a loose confederacy of five divisions—Chalahgawtha (Chillicothe), Mekoche, Kispoko, Pekowi, and Hathawekela—each with traditional roles; Chillicothe…
features.quote: The Shawnee were a loose confederacy of five divisions—Chalahgawtha (Chillicothe), Mekoche, Kispoko, Pekowi, and Hathawekela—each with traditional roles; Chillicothe customarily supplied political leadership.

layers.name: Fort Boonesborough
layers.blurb: Daniel Boone’s 1775 settlement on the Kentucky River — Capital of the Colony of Transylvania.

layers.name: Big Bone Lick
layers.blurb: A Pleistocene salt lick where mastodons left bones in the mud — Kentucky’s window on deep time.
